ONE LINEAR MODEL, TWO VIEWS.zh: 一个线性模型，两种视角

One line cannot learn XOR. One more colu.zh: 直线无法学会 XOR，再加一列特征就可以。
One line cannot learn XOR. One more colu.src: One line cannot learn XOR. One more column can.

Train a logistic regression on XOR and w.zh: 在 XOR 上训练逻辑回归，观察最优的直线如何失效。随后追加特征 x@@T0@@1@@T1@@x@@T2@@2@@T3@@：同一个线性模型用一个三维平面将提升后的数据点分开；从正上方俯视该平面，得到的正是输入平面中的那条曲线。
Train a logistic regression on XOR and w.src: Train a logistic regression on XOR and watch the best possible line fail. Then append the feature x<sub>1</sub>x<sub>2</sub>: the same linear model separates the lifted points with a flat plane in three dimensions, and that plane, seen from above, is the curve you get in the input plane.

The boundary z = 0 is linear in the feat.zh: 决策边界 z = 0 在特征 (x@@T0@@1@@T1@@, x@@T2@@2@@T3@@, φ) 中是线性的。本实验中的每一个控件都只改变数据或 φ，分类器本身始终保持线性。
The boundary z = 0 is linear in the feat.src: The boundary z = 0 is linear in the features (x<sub>1</sub>, x<sub>2</sub>, φ). Every control in this lab changes only the data or φ. The classifier stays linear throughout.

The dashed line is ln 2, the loss of pre.zh: 虚线为 ln 2，即处处预测 0.5 的损失。逻辑损失是凸的，因此梯度下降能收敛到所选特征下的最优权重。
The dashed line is ln 2, the loss of pre.src: The dashed line is ln 2, the loss of predicting 0.5 everywhere. The logistic loss is convex, so gradient descent reaches the best weights for the chosen features.

Suppose a line puts both blue corners, (.zh: 假设某条直线把两个蓝色角点 (1, 1) 与 (−1, −1) 都放在正侧。半平面是凸集，故它也包含二者的中点，即原点。对两个橙色角点 (1, −1) 与 (−1, 1) 施以同样的论证，则原点落在负侧。矛盾。
Suppose a line puts both blue corners, (.src: Suppose a line puts both blue corners, (1, 1) and (−1, −1), on its positive side. A half-plane is convex, so it also contains their midpoint, the origin. The same argument for the orange corners (1, −1) and (−1, 1) puts the origin on the negative side. Contradiction.

Training is not the problem. The logisti.zh: 问题不在训练。逻辑损失关于 (w, b) 是凸的，故梯度下降能到达全局最优；而在对称的 XOR 上，该最优解为 w = 0：处处预测 0.5，损失为 ln 2。
Training is not the problem. The logisti.src: Training is not the problem. The logistic loss is convex in (w, b), so gradient descent reaches the global optimum, and on symmetric XOR that optimum is w = 0: predict 0.5 everywhere, loss ln 2.

On the corners the new column x@@T0@@1@@.zh: 在角点上，新列 x@@T0@@1@@T1@@x@@T2@@2@@T3@@ 对蓝色取 +1、对橙色取 −1，因而它自身就能分开两类。权重 (0, 0, −1) 给出 z = −x@@T4@@1@@T5@@x@@T6@@2@@T7@@：蓝色上 p = σ(−1) ≈ 0.27，橙色上 σ(+1) ≈ 0.73；增大 w@@T8@@3@@T9@@ 可使二者同时更锐利。
On the corners the new column x@@T0@@1@@.src: On the corners the new column x<sub>1</sub>x<sub>2</sub> is +1 for blue and −1 for orange, so it separates the classes on its own. The weights (0, 0, −1) give z = −x<sub>1</sub>x<sub>2</sub>: p = σ(−1) ≈ 0.27 on blue, σ(+1) ≈ 0.73 on orange, and scaling w<sub>3</sub> sharpens both.

In feature space that boundary is the fl.zh: 在特征空间中，该边界是平面 u@@T0@@3@@T1@@ = 0。加入乘积特征并训练，观察平面如何稳定在其附近。
In feature space that boundary is the fl.src: In feature space that boundary is the flat sheet u<sub>3</sub> = 0. Train with the product feature and watch the plane settle near it.

In feature coordinates the boundary is b.src: In feature coordinates the boundary is b + w<sub>1</sub>u<sub>1</sub> + w<sub>2</sub>u<sub>2</sub> + w<sub>3</sub>u<sub>3</sub> = 0, a plane, flat by construction. Substitute u<sub>3</sub> = x<sub>1</sub>x<sub>2</sub> and solve: x<sub>2</sub> = −(b + w<sub>1</sub>x<sub>1</sub>) / (w<sub>2</sub> + w<sub>3</sub>x<sub>1</sub>), a hyperbola with asymptotes x<sub>1</sub> = −w<sub>2</sub>/w<sub>3</sub> and x<sub>2</sub> = −w<sub>1</sub>/w<sub>3</sub>.

Press Edge-on to see the plane as a line.zh: 点击侧视可将平面看作一条直线，再点击俯视可看到其迹线即左侧的曲线。同一个对象，两种投影。
Press Edge-on to see the plane as a line.src: Press Edge-on to see the plane as a line, then Top to see its trace as the curve on the left. Same object, two projections.

The decoy x@@T0@@1@@T1@@² + x@@T2@@2@@T3.zh: 干扰特征 x@@T0@@1@@T1@@² + x@@T2@@2@@T3@@² 在每个角点上都等于 2，因而无助于分类：有用的特征必须在不同类别间取值不同。ReLU 特征 max(0, x@@T4@@1@@T5@@ + x@@T6@@2@@T7@@ − 1) 是权重为 (1, 1)、偏置为 −1 的单个隐藏神经元，此处由手工设定。它标记出 (1, 1) 角点，与那条直线配合即可解出 XOR。
The decoy x@@T0@@1@@T1@@² + x@@T2@@2@@T3.src: The decoy x<sub>1</sub>² + x<sub>2</sub>² equals 2 at every corner and helps nobody: a useful feature must differ across classes. The ReLU feature max(0, x<sub>1</sub> + x<sub>2</sub> − 1) is one hidden neuron with weights (1, 1) and bias −1, chosen by hand. It flags the (1, 1) corner, and with the line it solves XOR.

A hidden layer is a bank of such units w.zh: 隐藏层就是这样一组单元的集合，其权重由同样的梯度下降学习得到。ReLU 演练场展示了这一过程。
A hidden layer is a bank of such units w.src: A hidden layer is a bank of such units whose weights are learned by the same gradient descent. The ReLU playground shows that happening.

meta.title: XOR 与特征提升
meta.tagline: 观察最优直线如何在 XOR 上失效，再引入一列 x₁x₂，看三维平面如何化为二维曲线
meta.summary: 在 XOR 上训练逻辑回归，观察梯度下降停在随机损失 ln 2 处，因为任何直线都无法分开四个角点。追加特征 x₁x₂ 后，同一个线性模型用一个三维平面将提升后的数据分开。环绕该平面，从侧面观察，再从顶部俯视：它在鞍面上的迹线正是你在输入平面中看到的那条双曲线。
highlights: 在 XOR 上手工调参或训练逻辑回归，观察损失稳定在 ln 2 ≈ 0.693，即猜测概率 0.5 的损失。
加入 x₁x₂ 列，看数据点被提升到鞍面上，由一个平面将两类分开。
环绕特征空间，将视点与平面平行，再从顶部俯视，还原出二维的双曲线边界。
尝试一个无助于分类的干扰特征，以及一个手工构造的 ReLU 特征，后者通向隐藏层。
